description: S6 in the AWS environment. One order message whose amount is not a number reaches the queue-consumer's SQS queue. No revision can process it, so it fails on every receive and keeps returning, its approximate receive count rising, while the other orders pass through. A benign queue-consumer v1.4.1 task definition rolls out through ECS 30 s later, before the queue's oldest message crosses the detection threshold. Fidelity: the queue, its dead-letter queue, the ECS service and its rollout run on local AWS; the consumer and its telemetry are real; the poison message is injected through the SQS API.

noise.notes: The consumer's own producer sends four orders a second to SQS; the poison message returns at once after each failure, held two seconds by the worker that failed on it.
